construction: Study the domes, control sticks, loudhailer, antenna and wing panel as a small directed composition.
interfaces: Reserve the protruding antenna and bar envelope; attach the underlying plate to exposed studs, not through finished hull tiles.
lesson: Small familiar LEGO fittings can suggest machinery when arranged in a coherent recessed service bay.
parent_context: 10179-1.mpd supplies the surrounding hull recess. This is the right upper service cluster, not an entire Falcon panel.
reuse_notes: Keep greebles grouped and lower than the main silhouette. Reuse their mounting logic; avoid covering every hull surface with unrelated decoration.
